title_en: Visions of the Future (18/20): The Real Road to Mars
note_en: 与其…不如… weighs two options and rejects the first: "rather than A, better to B." In 与其急着移民火星，不如先把资源用来保护地球, the option after 与其 (rushing to settle Mars) is the one being turned down, and 不如 introduces the preferred choice. English often reverses the order ("we'd do better to protect Earth than rush to Mars"), but Chinese always puts the rejected option first.
